1.title: ‘Tell Us Where to Look,’ Savannah Guthrie Pleads 6 Months Into Search
1.summary: The “Today” show host spoke directly to her mother’s apparent abductor in a new video.

2.title: Trump Asks Supreme Court to Allow Order Restricting Mail Voting
2.summary: The Trump administration asks justices to intervene after an appeals court blocked key parts of a mail-in voting executive order.

3.title: Hiker Trekked 10 Miles to Safety After Impaling Himself on Pole
3.summary: David Cifaldi was hiking up Granite Peak, Montana’s tallest mountain last week when he slipped and fell on one of his trekking poles. A wound nurse, he went into survival mode.

4.title: Wildfires Live Updates: New Heat Wave Could Worsen France and Spain’s ‘Unprecedented’ Fire Season
4.summary: Firefighters and volunteers raced to contain wildfires on Monday. The crisis has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in central Spain and southwest France.

5.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of teen
5.summary: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.

6.title: In Washington, Netanyahu Faces a Delicate Balancing Act
6.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel is set to meet President Trump on Tuesday, with one eye on Iran and another on the coming elections back home.
